svg.title: EH3D-COMMON architecture
svg.desc: EH3D-COMMON holds the .eh3dproj project container with its metadata and SHA-256 integrity record, the machine telemetry types, the colours of the suite, and the firmware base that every ESP32 node copies. Programs that open or save a project are planned to depend on it; today the only user is the firmware base inside EH3D-NODE-BUNGARD. Everything is tested on a computer; nothing has run on a board.
